line-d.name: Line D (under construction)
line-d.description: Prague's fourth line, driverless, from Náměstí Míru through Nusle and Pankrác to Krč, Libuš and the Písnice depot. Pankrác–Ryšánka has been under construction since April 2022 and Ryšánka–Nové Dvory since June 2026; Nové Dvory–Depo Písnice and Pankrác–Náměstí Míru follow, with opening planned for 2032–2036.

line-d-extensions.name: Line D extensions
line-d-extensions.description: Further reaches of line D in the city's plans: on from Náměstí Míru to Hlavní nádraží and Náměstí Republiky and a branch from Nové Dvory to Modřany, both in the 2026 Metropolitan Plan, and the 2018 idea of going on from Náměstí Republiky across Žižkov to Chmelnice and Vysočany. None is being prepared.

line-a-airport.name: Line A to the airport
line-a-airport.description: The 2005 decision to take line A past Motol through Bílá Hora, Dědina and Dlouhá Míle to Ruzyně airport, with a branch from Bílá Hora to Řepy and Zličín; only Dejvická–Nemocnice Motol was built (2015). A 2018 study costed the airport leg at 26.8 bn CZK, but the city chose the Kladno railway for the airport instead.

line-a-hostivar.name: Line A Hostivař branch
line-a-hostivar.description: A long-term branch of line A from Strašnická through Nádraží Strašnice, Zahradní Město and Na Groši to Nádraží Hostivař. Dropped from the 2009 draft plan; the 2026 Metropolitan Plan keeps only a reserve towards Zahradní Město.

line-c-cakovice.name: Line C to Čakovice (2018)
line-c-cakovice.description: A 2018 city proposal to extend line C 3.5 km from Letňany to Čakovice with three new stations, for about 16 bn CZK. The 2026 Metropolitan Plan does not include it.

line-b-west.name: Line B: Depo Zličín and Západní Město

names.cs: Linka B: Depo Zličín a Západní Město

line-b-west.description: Two small western additions to line B: a station at the Zličín depot, studied in 2020 and kept in the 2026 Metropolitan Plan, and a 2 km branch from Stodůlky to the planned Západní Město district, in the 2009 draft plan but left out of the final 2026 one.

line-o-2022.name: Circle line O (2022)
line-o-2022.description: A 36 km, 23-station circle line put forward in the city council in February 2022 from Nádraží Podbaba through Strahov, Smíchov, Pankrác, Eden, Žižkov, Libeň and Prosek to Čakovice and the planned high-speed rail Terminál Sever; the city set up a working group and a feasibility study brief. Its northern arc beyond Čakovice was unnamed and is left out.

study-1987.name: 1987 study
study-1987.description: A June 1987 network study: a line D from the Písnice meat plant through Krč, Olbrachtova (today's Ryšánka), Pankrác, Náměstí Bratří Synků (today's Nusle), Náměstí Míru and Žižkov to Lidových milicí (today's Vysočanská), Letňany and Kbely, and a circle line E through Palmovka, Letná, Hradčanská, Smíchov and Pankrác, to be built from 1995 to after 2010. Its southern half became today's line D project; line C took the route to Letňany.
